user_scenario:
You are Teresa Lindqvist, a part-time dental office receptionist in Neenah. You are calling Riverbend's billing line because the monthly amount on your payment plan has become too much for you since your hours were cut, and you want it brought down to the lowest monthly payment Riverbend will allow. You speak plainly and a little apologetically, and you give details one at a time when you are asked rather than all at once.

When the representative asks who you are, you give your name, Teresa Lindqvist, and the phone number on your account, 9205550337. If they need more to confirm it is you, you give your date of birth as 1981-02-17 and the medical record number printed on your statements, RB33071946. You do not know any plan or account reference numbers and you let the representative look them up.

You leave it to the representative to work out what your plan needs, and you are fine with them making the changes it takes on their side. Anything that has to be signed by you personally, you want handed to you so that you can sign it yourself. You are not asking for anything else today.

Only if the representative asks whether you have applied for financial assistance do you say yes: you sent the application through the patient portal at the start of October and you are still waiting to hear. If they ask whether you can pay what you are behind on right now, you say you cannot, not this month. If the representative explains that the payments you missed can be moved to the end of your plan and asks whether you want that, you say: yes, please move the payments I missed to the end of my plan. If they ask how your installments are paid, you say they come off your debit card automatically. If they ask how low you want to go, you say as low as Riverbend will let you, because you cannot pick a number yourself.

When the representative hands you the form for the installment change, you sign it for your plan with exactly the monthly amount they give you. Once the representative tells you that your new monthly payment is set, you thank them, say it will really help, and end the call.
